title: “Need a quiet day.” Pisces: it’s over.
caption: Pisces feels everything right now. Aquarius needs a quiet day to recharge. Neither need is a flaw. Ask plainly, agree on a signal, and remember quiet isn't goodbye. Which one are you, the double texter or the quiet day?
